rationale: Salesforce CRMA developers are a real, paying B2B segment, and the pain (null-value bugs blocking dashboard-driven automation) is genuine and recurring. However, the solution is fundamentally a Salesforce AppExchange component or a deep Apex/LWC integration — it cannot be built with Claude + a landing page + Stripe; it requires Salesforce-certified development, AppExchange security review, and per-org deployment support, all of which are far outside the solo non-technical operator model. Operational autonomy is also very low because each client implementation requires Salesforce org-specific configuration and troubleshooting. Both buildability_with_ai and operational_autonomy fail build gates decisively, and the total falls below the validate threshold.
solution_plan: This would need to be a Salesforce consulting accelerator or AppExchange managed package — neither is achievable by a non-technical solo operator without a certified Salesforce developer partner. The build path (Apex triggers, LWC components, AppExchange security review) is months of work; the sell path (Salesforce partner ecosystem, AppExchange listing) requires ISV certification; and maintenance involves per-org debugging and Salesforce release compatibility. Honest verdict: this is firmly a specialist Salesforce consultancy play, not a Claude-factory micro-service. Drop.
